title: Panic-chan
overview:
Over 90 minutes of animation included! A new genre, the "OVA Adventure," is born!!

You work at a video rental store that is short on staff. Then Panic-chan shows up - a cute girl who leaves chaos everywhere she goes - and her rival Trouble-chan is never far behind. Follow their slapstick antics in an anime adventure told through text scenes and full animation, with characters designed by Takahiro Kimura.

- Panic-chan voiced by Miwa Yanagihara, Trouble-chan by Miki Nagasawa
- Memory backup

90分を越えるアニメーションを収録！新ジャンル「OVAアドベンチャー」誕生!!
